name: 키즈노트
summary: 선생님이 올린 알림장과 사진, 원 공지를 두리가 대신 읽어 드리고, 약 먹일 일이 있으면 투약의뢰서도 써 둘게요. 원에 보내는 건 승인하신 뒤에만 보내요.

example.reply: 오후 4시 10분에 알림장이 올라왔어요. 간식은 조금 남겼고 낮잠은 50분 잤대요. 바깥 놀이 사진도 7장 있어요.

abilities.title: 투약의뢰서
abilities.say: 내일 점심 먹고 해열제 먹여 달라고 써 줘

en.name: Kidsnote
en.summary: Dool2 reads your teacher's notes, photos and notices for you and writes medication request forms. Anything sent to the school goes out only after you approve.

example.ask: What did the teacher write today?
example.reply: A note was posted at 4:10 PM. Snack was mostly eaten and a nap lasted 50 minutes. There are 7 outdoor play photos too.

abilities.title: Album photos
abilities.say: Are yesterday's field trip photos up?

abilities.title: Medication request
abilities.say: Write a request for a fever reducer after lunch tomorrow

abilities.title: Notices
abilities.say: Is there a notice about what to bring next week?
